title: Rust Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Rust at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes Cargo in Rust?

options.text: Cargo builds tests and manages crate metadata
use cargo check test and run as separate evidence
Cargo.lock policy differs between applications and libraries
The compiler silently repairs the design

questions.explanation: Cargo builds tests and manages crate metadata. Confirm with cargo check, Clippy, and a focused test.
